locations.name: Central Plaza
locations.description: The heart of Neo Terra. A broad public square ringed by screens, food stalls, and memorials to crises survived. Rallies, emergencies, and impromptu superhero interviews all happen here.

locations.name: PetraByte Tower
locations.description: A needle of glass and light above Downtown. PetraByte's headquarters, superhero operations hub, and the Petrauskas family's public seat of power.

locations.name: Clarity Incorporated HQ
locations.description: A polished black monolith with impossible views and very private basement levels. The public sees a model corporation; the city's underworld sees the landlord.

locations.name: Gold Paradise Casino
locations.description: Neon, velvet, and carefully laundered money. Jacqueline Webb deals cards here; criminals, heroes, and information brokers share tables without asking too many questions.

locations.name: Matic Estate
locations.description: A sprawling old-money house with a fashion studio grafted onto it. Monika and Amy Matic's home and a recurring refuge for heroes who need somewhere to regroup.

locations.name: Corvus Corp Atelier
locations.description: Part factory, part fashion house, all Monicium. Superheroes come here for repairs and new suits; the non-superhero side quietly funds half the city's reconstruction.

locations.name: Siren's Styles
locations.description: The loudest storefront on Fashion Row. Amy Matic's boutique designs superhero suits for clients who care more about silhouette than stealth.

locations.name: Neo Terra PD Headquarters
locations.description: A reinforced civic building with a rooftop signal rig tied into the Superhero Social Network. The dispatchers here know they are the second call, not the first.

locations.name: Neo Terra General Hospital
locations.description: The city's main trauma centre. Its metahuman ward has reinforced walls, anonymous intake, and a standing agreement with PetraByte.

locations.name: Neon Docks
locations.description: Container stacks, black water, and unlicensed cranes. Clarity shipments arrive here; so do people who want to disappear.

locations.name: Sand Shine Town
locations.description: A smaller coastal town beyond the city limits, home to the Menis siblings. Its beach and boardwalk make it a quiet escape until someone drags a storm ashore.

locations.name: Rust Yard
locations.description: Dead factories, salvage crews, and cheap workshops. The perfect place to hide a lab, a body, or a dangerous experiment.

locations.name: Beast Conversion Facility
locations.description: An unmarked research complex beneath a disused foundry. The Beast Conversion Program's holding cells, gene labs, and conditioning suites are here.

locations.name: The Old Subway
locations.description: Sealed tunnels and abandoned stations that predate the current city. Everyone from vigilantes to cultists uses them to move unseen.

locations.name: Maple Heights
locations.description: Tree-lined streets, old apartment blocks, and the kind of neighbours who notice a strange car. Civilian ground that villains keep trying to make personal.

locations.name: Ironhold Penitentiary
locations.description: A metahuman containment prison on the city's edge. Officially escape-proof. Officially.

locations.name: The Shuttered Skyscraper
locations.description: An unfinished office tower nobody officially owns. Midnight Treat watches the city from its dark floors, and the treats she gifts are never far away.

locations.name: Renya Shrine
locations.description: A stone-and-bone compound hidden in the old hills, half temple and half war camp. The Renya Clan gathers here when it wants the city to remember what came before it.
